'''Longford Town Football Club''' is an Irish professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Longford]], County Longford. The club, which was founded in 1924 and elected to the league in 1984,<ref name="LOI">{{cite web |url=http://www.airtricityleague.ie/clubs/first-division/longford-town/club-information |title=Longford Town Club Information |date=9 February 2009 |work=airtricityleague.ie |access-date=7 September 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120922045422/http://www.airtricityleague.ie/clubs/first-division/longford-town/club-information |archive-date=22 September 2012 }}</ref> plays in the [[League of Ireland First Division]]. 

The club plays its home matches at [[Strokestown Road]], which for sponsorship reasons is also known as Bishopsgate. The club, whose colours are red and black, sometimes goes by the nickname 'De Town'.<ref>{{cite web|url = https://ltfc.ie/2025/01/jamal-ibrahim-re-signs-for-2025/ | website = ltfc.ie | title = Jamal Ibrahim Re-Signs for 2025 | accessdate = 1 February 2025 | quote = The powerful winger re-joined De Town last summer from Athlone }}</ref> Its crest contains a silhouette of [[St Mel's Cathedral]] in Longford.<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.independent.ie/opinion/a-cathedral-that-survived-famine-fire-and-recession-rises-again-as-a-symbol-of-hope/30851397.html | work = Irish Independent | title = A cathedral that survived famine, fire and recession rises again as a symbol of hope | date = 20 December 2014 | accessdate = 6 February 2025 }}</ref>

Longford Town had a number of successes in domestic competitions, including winning the League of Ireland First Division (in 2014), [[FAI Cup]] (in 2003 and 2004) and [[League of Ireland Cup]] (in 2004).<ref name="loiInfo">{{cite web|url = https://www.leagueofireland.ie/news/longford-town-club-information/ | website = leagueofireland.ie | title = Longford Town - Club Information | date = 16 November 2023 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20240809181429/https://www.leagueofireland.ie/news/longford-town-club-information/ | archive-date = 9 August 2024 }}</ref>"}}
